d:
Bharat ka sanvidhan keval ek kanuni dastavej nahin, balki desh ki vividhta, samanta, samajik nyay aur loktantrik mulyon ko ek sutr men bandhne vala aitihasik sankalp hai. sanvidhan nirman ki is aitihasik prakriya men bihar ki bhumika bhi behad mahatvapurn rahi. sanvidhan sabha men bihar ke 36 pratinidhi shamil the, jinhonne alag-alag samajik, rajnitik aur vaicharik prishthabhumi se aakar desh ki bhavi vyavastha ko lekar apne vichar rakhe the.
